constraints: Can only be used if wpArea is associated with a form object (i.e. displayed in the current form/page).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Gets the cursor frame when wpArea is passed as a form object name (string), signalled by the leading * flag.

discriminatedBy.rule: Presence of the leading * literal indicates wpArea is a form object name; its absence (see sibling overload) indicates wpArea is a field/variable.

overloadMerges.note: autoparse defaulted textBoxID to direction:in; the parameter table marks it '←' (out) -- it is only filled when a text box currently has the focus.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Gets the cursor frame when wpArea is passed directly as a 4D Write Pro object field or variable (no leading * flag).

discriminatedBy.rule: No leading * literal; wpArea is a Variable or Field reference rather than a form object name string.

overloadMerges.note: autoparse defaulted textBoxID to direction:in; the parameter table marks it '←' (out) -- it is only filled when a text box currently has the focus.
